```
import pytest
from langfuse.api.comments.client import CommentsClient

class DummyResp:
    def __init__(self):
        self.data = "ok"

class DummyRaw:
    def __init__(self):
        self.called = False
    def create(self, **kwargs):
        self.called = True
        return DummyResp()

def test_create_comment_length_limit():
    client = CommentsClient(client_wrapper=object())
    client._raw_client = DummyRaw()
    # content too long
    long_content = "a" * 5001
    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc:
        client.create(project_id="p", object_type="ot", object_id="oid", content=long_content)
    assert "5000" in str(exc.value)
    # valid content
    client.create(project_id="p", object_type="ot", object_id="oid", content="short")
    assert client._raw_client.called
```
